$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：紫微天府坐寅申，《深造講義》p.97。

basis.quote: 须注意其为主动，抑或被动

rules.text: 主動的一面較重：你攻守皆宜，可進可退。
rules.en: The active side is stronger: you can attack or defend, advance or hold back.

source.quote: 属于主动性质的[紫微天府]则攻守咸宜

rules.text: 被動的一面較重：你容易進退失據，想進又不敢進，想退又不肯退，事事只能全力應付環境。
rules.en: The passive side is stronger: you're prone to indecision, wanting to advance but not daring, wanting to retreat but not willing, so you end up spending everything just coping with circumstances.

source.quote: 这吋就反而事事陷于被动

rules.text: 會照的武曲化科，與天府配合得好，紫微天府兩面的矛盾不會太深。
rules.en: Wu Qu transformed by Ke in your trine works well with Tian Fu, so the tension between Zi Wei and Tian Fu doesn't run deep.

rules.text: 會照的武曲化權，令紫微主動的色彩增加，人生的波折比一般大。
rules.en: Wu Qu transformed by Quan in your trine strengthens Zi Wei's drive, and life has more setbacks than usual.
rules.edit: 原句續講「三十前後多數要經過一次挫折」，屬年歲事件預言，不用。

source.quote: 可是人生的波折始终比武曲化科时为大

rules.text: 會照的武曲化祿，卻沒有祿存調和武曲的孤剋之氣，童年較為艱苦。
rules.en: Wu Qu transformed by Lu in your trine, without Lu Cun to dissolve its isolating edge, makes for a harder childhood.

source.quote: 所以若无禄存，则其人童年较为艰苦

rules.text: 天機所在的那一步運，帶來的不是實際的變動，而是想法上的轉變。
rules.en: The phase through Tian Ji brings not outward change but a change in your thinking.

rules.text: 天梁所在的那一步運，你一般不喜：那段時間多是退居幕後。
rules.en: The phase through Tian Liang is not to your liking: in that time you mostly step behind the scenes.

rules.text: 主動的你，行到武曲所在的運，一般有利。
rules.en: Being the proactive kind, the phase through Wu Qu generally favours you.

rules.text: 被動的你，行到破軍見擎羊陀羅的運，反而適合慢慢推進、扭轉劣勢；那段時間要慎選合作創業的夥伴。
rules.en: Being the reactive kind, a phase where Po Jun meets Qing Yang or Tuo Luo suits a slow advance that turns things round; in that time, choose business partners with care.

source.quote: 要慎于选择合作创业的伙伴
